name: Moth
description: The Moth was a MK-4 freighter owned by Owerto Naiucho, used for smuggling illegal goods. After the Battle of Endor, he used it to travel to the planet Akiva. Following the death of Owerto, the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley took ownership of the Moth. She and her team of Imperial hunters including her son Temmin Wexley would use the Moth to hunt down Imperial fugitives during the last stages of the Galactic Civil War.
